name: Jules Silva
title: Counsellor/Psychotherapist (PACFA Clinical)
address: Offer both face-to-face and Online/Telehealth sessions
description: Life can be so tough, at times: Perhaps you don’t feel good about 'you', you struggle with life feeling relentlessly stressful, expensive, and anxiety-provoking, your relationship is in trouble, work is overwhelming and unsatisfying, your friendships feel insecure, you grieve for the decline or death of a close other (or beloved pet), you are diagnosed with a fear-evoking illness, your mental health is out of kilter and you don't know how to get back on track, or you may be feeling a 'deep down' loss of meaning and purpose in an increasingly unstable and uncertain world. Or something else; we all have a story. Whilst I have particular interest in grief and loss, trauma, existential concerns (incl. climate change and related anxieties), and emotional self-regulation, I am deeply interested in all aspects of the experience and suffering that clients and couples bring 'to the room'.
specialties: Posttraumatic stress disorder, Trauma recovery, Somatic psychotherapy

name: Moniquea Spiteri
title: Counsellor/Psychotherapist (PACFA Clinical)
description: Areas listed on PACFA profile: Posttraumatic stress disorder, Trauma recovery.
specialties: Posttraumatic stress disorder, Trauma recovery, Somatic Experiencing, Somatic psychotherapy

name: Karolina Krysinska
title: Counsellor/Psychotherapist (PACFA Clinical)
description: I am a Gestalt psychotherapist with a background in psychology and 25 years of experience in the field of mental health. My work is based on respectful exploration of client’s experience in the here and now, including our ongoing psychotherapy relationship. My interest in Gestalt psychotherapy reflects my passion for a deeper understanding of psychological and emotional well-being and satisfactory human relationships.

name: Hannah Bruce
title: Counsellor/Psychotherapist (PACFA Clinical)
description: Hannah is a specialist trauma counsellor with deep experience supporting adult survivors of childhood trauma, complex PTSD, addiction, and victims of crime including those engaging with the National Redress Scheme. Hannah has worked across community mental health, addiction recovery, and trauma support services. Her practice is informed by EFT, somatic counselling, motivational interviewing, and the Blue Knot Foundation’s Clinical Practice Guidelines for Complex Trauma. Her areas of speciality include: • Childhood trauma and abuse • Complex PTSD and dissociation • Attachment and relational trauma • Substance use and addiction • Victims of crime and institutional harm • Emotional regulation, grief, and identity Hannah offers a compassionate, steady presence and works at a pace that respects each client’s safety and readiness.
specialties: Posttraumatic stress disorder, Trauma recovery, Somatic Experiencing, Somatic psychotherapy

name: Daniel Perkins
title: Counsellor/Psychotherapist (PACFA Certified Practising)
description: Specialising in the use of neurofeedback for the treatment of anxiety, depression, PTSD, complex/childhood trauma, ADHD.

name: Julia Gorda
title: Counsellor/Psychotherapist (PACFA Certified Practising)
practice: The Path to Balance Yoga and Counselling
description: My approach is trauma-informed, relational, and body-based, integrating traditional counselling with yoga-informed therapeutic practices to support nervous system regulation, recovery, and emotional balance. I work in a collaborative and non-judgemental way, supporting clients to build awareness of patterns, reconnect with their bodies, and develop greater choice and self-support in the present moment. My work is informed by Gestalt therapy principles, particularly in the context of addiction and recovery, helping clients explore how stress, trauma, and substance use impact both inner experience and relationships.

name: Waltraud Reiner
title: Counsellor/Psychotherapist (PACFA Clinical)
description: Growing up in a rural country in Austria has given me a strong sense for improvising and seeing materials out of context. To address her own experience of trauma and adversity, Waltraud has learnt the value of analytic therapy. Just as a painter needs to discover the skills to select brushes and paints, so do our psyches need to discover which parts of themselves to shine and polish.
specialties: Posttraumatic stress disorder, Trauma recovery, Somatic psychotherapy

name: Bharati Susarla
title: Counsellor/Psychotherapist (PACFA Clinical)
description: I offer a compassionate counselling service that is both sensitive and understanding of cultural context. In the therapeutic space that I will create for you, you will be at all times treated with respect and genuinity of care and understanding. I am very particular about listening to what you have to say and in doing so, will be able to sensitively help you explore those aspects of your life, emotions, thoughts and feelings that may be causing you pain.
